import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        int mod = sc.nextInt();

        int[][] binom = new int[n + 1][n + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            binom[i][0] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
                binom[i][j] = (binom[i - 1][j - 1] + binom[i - 1][j]) % mod;
            }
        }

        long[] f = new long[n + 1];
        long[] g = new long[n + 1];
        f[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
                int k = i - j - 1;
                f[i] = (f[i] + (f[j] * f[k] % mod) * (i + 1) % mod * binom[i - 1][j]) % mod;
                g[i] = (g[i] + (g[j] * f[k] % mod) * (i + 1) % mod * binom[i - 1][j]) % mod;
                g[i] = (g[i] + (f[j] * g[k] % mod) * (i + 1) % mod * binom[i - 1][j]) % mod;
                long sumTerms = ((long)j * (j + 1) / 2) + ((long)k * (k + 1) / 2);
                g[i] = (g[i] + (f[j] * f[k] % mod) * binom[i - 1][j] % mod * sumTerms % mod) % mod;
            }
        }

        long[][][] dp = new long[n + 2][n + 2][2];
        dp[0][0][1] = 1;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= i; j++) {
                dp[i + 1][j][1] = (dp[i + 1][j][1] + dp[i][j][0] + dp[i][j][1]) % mod;
                for (int k = 0; k <= n - i; k++) {
                    int ni = i + k;
                    int nj = j + k;
                    if (ni <= n && nj <= n) {
                        long val = (dp[i][j][1] * f[k] % mod) * binom[j + k][j] % mod;
                        dp[ni][nj][0] = (dp[ni][nj][0] + val) % mod;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        long total_ans = 0;
        for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
            for (int i = 0; i <= j; i++) {
                int rem = m - (j - i + 1);
                if (rem < 0) continue;
                for (int k = 0; k <= rem; k++) {
                    long temp = (g[j - i + 1] * dp[i - 1][k][1] % mod) * dp[n - j][rem - k][1] % mod;
                    temp = temp * binom[m][rem] % mod * binom[rem][k] % mod;
                    total_ans = (total_ans + temp) % mod;
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(total_ans);
        sc.close();
    }
}
